core.label: Getting Started
core.desc: Learn the basics in about 2 minutes.

welcome.title: Welcome to Interior Studio
welcome.description:
A quick tour of the key features.

Follow along to start designing your first floor plan.

sidebar.title: The Catalog
sidebar.description:
Browse furniture, openings (doors & windows), and custom models here.

Drag any tile onto the canvas to place it.

canvas.title: Your Floor Plan
canvas.description:
This is the 2D canvas. Click to start drawing a wall, then click again to finish it.

Scroll to zoom · Space + drag to pan.

draw-wall.title: Drawing Walls
draw-wall.description:
Walls snap to 45° angle increments by default.

Hold Shift for 90° only · Hold Alt for free angle.

Walls chain automatically — click to keep extending.

properties.title: Properties Panel
properties.description:
Select any wall, furniture item, room, or opening to edit its properties here.

Dimensions, materials, colors, and more.

view-3d.title: Switch to 3D
view-3d.description:
Press this button to see your floor plan as a fully rendered 3D room.

Lighting, textures, and furniture all appear in 3D.

save.title: Save Your Work
save.description:
Save exports your project as a .studio.json file you can reopen later.

Your work is also kept in browser storage automatically.

done.title: You're Ready!
done.description:
That covers the basics. Want to go deeper?

Pick a topic below or close to start designing.

materials.label: Materials & Colors
materials.desc: Apply floor, ceiling, and wall finishes.

mat-intro.title: Materials & Colors
mat-intro.description: Learn how to apply floor finishes, ceiling materials, and wall colors to your design.

mat-room.title: Select a Room
mat-room.description:
Click inside any enclosed room polygon on the canvas to select it.

The room highlight turns blue when selected.

mat-floor-picker.title: Floor Material
mat-floor-picker.description:
Choose from wood, tile, marble, carpet, concrete and more.

Hover any swatch to see the material name.
mat-floor-picker.prereq: Select a room on the canvas first to see the floor picker.

mat-ceiling.title: Ceiling Material
mat-ceiling.description:
The ceiling picker works the same way.

Ceilings are visible in the 3D view.
mat-ceiling.prereq: Select a room on the canvas first to see the ceiling picker.

mat-3d.title: Preview in 3D
mat-3d.description: Switch to 3D to see your materials rendered with full PBR textures.

viewer3d.label: 3D Viewer & Walkthrough
viewer3d.desc: Orbit, navigate, and walk through your room.

3d-intro.title: 3D Viewer
3d-intro.description: Click here to switch to the 3D view. Your floor plan becomes a fully rendered room.

3d-canvas.title: Orbit & Navigate
3d-canvas.description:
Left-drag to orbit · Right-drag to pan · Scroll to zoom.

Click any wall, furniture, or room to select it from 3D.

3d-lighting.title: Lighting Controls
3d-lighting.description: Toggle lights · Drag the time slider to change the sun angle and color · Adjust ambient strength.

3d-walk.title: Walkthrough Mode
3d-walk.description:
Press Walk to lock the cursor and move through your room in first-person.

WASD to move · Shift to run · Space to jump · Esc to exit.

openings.label: Doors & Windows
openings.desc: Place and configure openings on walls.

op-intro.title: Doors & Windows
op-intro.description: Find doors, windows, and arch openings in the Openings section of the catalog.

op-drop.title: Place on a Wall
op-drop.description:
Drag any opening tile onto the canvas and hover over a wall.

A blue snap preview appears when you're close enough to a wall.

op-props.title: Opening Properties
op-props.description:
Select a door or window to edit width, height, color, and material.

Doors have swing direction and open-toward controls.

op-drag.title: Reposition Openings
op-drag.description:
Drag a placed door or window along its wall to reposition it.

It stays clamped within the wall and away from other openings.

ai-button.title: AI Assistant
ai-button.description: Click AI to open the assistant panel. It can suggest layouts, materials, and furniture arrangements.

ai-key.title: API Key
ai-key.description:
Enter your Google Gemini API key (free at aistudio.google.com).

The key is kept in this browser session only — never sent anywhere except Google.

ai-prompt.title: Ask Anything
ai-prompt.description:
Describe what you want: "add a sofa and coffee table to the living room" or "suggest a color palette".

The AI sees your current floor plan.

ai-apply.title: Apply Proposals
ai-apply.description:
When the AI suggests layout changes, an Apply button appears.

Preview the diff overlay on the canvas, then apply or discard.
